pins.definition: A word said when you meet someone.
A word said when you meet someone.
A polite word said when greeting someone formally or greeting more than one person.

situation: Two neighbours meet on a small-town street and stop to acknowledge one another.
subject: the act of greeting
brief: Two people are standing on a quiet cobblestone street, each with one hand raised in a friendly wave as they stop walking to face each other. The composition is bright and clear, showing the exact moment their paths converge and the greeting is exchanged.
